title: PCB_enclosure
subtitle: Design
description: Designed a PCB enclosure in SolidWorks, where I learned how to use the Vent feature to provide adequate ventilation for the internal components. Throughout the project, I also improved my understanding of the Extruded Cut feature for creating precise openings and internal geometry. The project took approximately 15 minutes to complete. Additionally, I learned how to select appropriate materials for the application, reducing the enclosure's weight from 750 g in the initial design to 450 g in the optimized version while maintaining its functionality..
problem: Design a Compact Electronics Enclosure (DFM/CAD focus).
